name: Anokhi Reet
about: An ethnic-wear rental and shopping app in India: rent or buy outfits for weddings and festivals, from local shops and vendors, by city.

rules: Two grounds only: warm cream for most slides and scenes, the maroon gradient for title and brand moments. No other backgrounds, no generic glows or neon gradients.
Colours only from this palette and its gradients. Shadows are soft and maroon-tinted (e.g. 0 20px 60px rgba(74,0,2,0.18)), never hard black.

Inter is the brand font for everything, headlines included (SemiBold/Bold for headlines, Regular for body). Arya only for Hindi. No other fonts. Keep normal letter spacing (no negative tracking); small uppercase labels may track out a little (0.05-0.08em).
Copy short and balanced: a few words per line, one idea per slide or scene.
App screens appear inside a phone frame (draw a rounded black bezel around the capture), never as floating cut-out screenshots. Small rebuilt pieces (a chip, a card) are fine for close-ups.
Show a detail by zooming into the phone in one smooth move; point at a button with a soft highlight or a fingertip shadow, never a cartoon hand or an outlined circle.
Patterns from our own circle family only: the mandala, the seal ring, rosettes, bandhani dots. Never other brands' motifs (no arches or jharokhas).
Logos are never stretched, outlined, recoloured outside the palette or given effects. End with the wordmark and, when inviting downloads, 'Download the app' with the official store badges.
No dead air in videos: something new every second or so. Text lands on the cut.
9:16 (Reels/Stories): keep text and key content out of the top 270 px and bottom 350 px (the app's UI covers them), and away from the right edge buttons.
Sound: a supplied voiceover and/or music; no swish, whoosh or riser effects.

never_say.why: No prices in our own words (real app screens may show them).
No number claims like "2000+" or "1 lakh+".
